body:
extract_path="${1|/extract/to/path, "${extractToPath}"|}"
archive_path="${2|/path/to/archive, "${pathToArchive}"|}"
case ${archive_path} in
  -*) archive_path=./${archive_path} ;;
esac
(
  temporary_directory=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/shellman.XXXXXXXXXX") || exit
  status=0
  trap 'status=$?; trap - 0; rm -rf "${temporary_directory}"; exit "${status}"' 0
  trap 'exit 129' HUP
  trap 'exit 130' INT
  trap 'exit 143' TERM
  gzip -dc "${archive_path}.tar.gz" > "${temporary_directory}/archive.tar" &&
    (cd "${extract_path}" && tar -xf "${temporary_directory}/archive.tar")
)
description: decompress a .tar.gz file to specified path
